Season 4 episode guideEPISODE JOURNAL / THE GUIDE

How we verify episodes

Broadcast sources, viewing checks and clear update dates.

Broadcast dates and times

TRT 1 is the primary external source for the series’ broadcast slot, official episodes and previews. Our editorial calendar links the episode records and TRT references from one page.

View our broadcast calendar

Verified subtitle releases

The publisher confirmed the Urdu and English releases of Season 4 Episodes 1–4, original Episodes 84–87, and their viewing options on 13 October 2026. Released guides show Verified. Season 4 Episode 5, original Episode 88, remains upcoming.

What each date means

Original broadcast date
The date recorded for the Turkish television transmission.
TRT webpage date
The posting or update timestamp on an official webpage. It can differ from the broadcast date.
Verification date
The date the publisher confirmed the release and viewing options.
Subtitle upload time
The provider’s upload event. We do not infer it from a broadcast or verification date.

Story information

TRT synopses are the primary story source. Niazi episode articles provide a secondary check. We distinguish spoiler-free introductions, synopsis-based plot details and complete watched recaps. Endings are added only when supported by direct episode evidence.

Episode numbering

Season numbers restart; original Turkish numbering continues. We display both. Dubbed editions can use different cuts, so their numbers should not be assumed to match a subtitled broadcast.

Understand the two episode numbers

Provider recommendations and corrections

Great Nation is our preferred free platform with notifications. It appears before Makki TV, Niazi TV and Historical Point. Provider descriptions reflect publisher-supplied information. A later failed check should be recorded rather than silently overwriting a previous verification.

Current update method

Episode records and verification are maintained editorially. Automatic monitoring and Episode Journal email delivery are not connected yet.
